property_summary: For any caller and guess hash, after lockInGuess is called with 1 ether the stored block number for that caller in the reference contract is strictly greater than the current block number at the time of the call (it's set to block.number + 1), whereas the mutant sets it equal to the current block number, breaking that invariant for some inputs.
change_summary: Set the stored block to the current block number instead of the next block, changing which block is later used when observing the state.
